findings.reason: the fallback decides what the record says about imas-efit's provenance, and as written it produces a false negative and a stale pointer instead of reading the edge flag from the output.
findings.text: §8 clause (1) asserts "Where imas-efit records one of these in neither place, as it does for the edge constraint … names imas-efit's plan equilibrium-fit-provenance as the work that will carry it", but that plan is `data-status="done"` and its landed record reads the edge constraint back out of the published equilibria ("Bernstein selector 8 with the edge constraint on (flag 1, the last Bernstein function identically zero)", eqfp-three-cases.html) and reports the resolved fit written into `equilibrium.code.parameters` (eqfp-fit-configuration.html), so a worker following the fallback would write into the §8 record a claimed absence its own imas-efit output disproves and cite completed work as pending

findings.reason: the stored map's axis is the section's stated reason a pass differs from the refusals, so a worker must invent clause (1)'s starting map or apply the §2 map to states that have none.
findings.text: §9 says a pass is "started on every case from the flux map imas-efit stored, which has an axis on all three", but clause (1) runs on the three §1 states (the Solov'ev certificate row, the MAST state and the ITER state), which are nova forward states with no stored imas-efit reconstruction, while the stored maps belong to §2's MAST-U/TCV/ITER cases, so "every case" names a starting flux map that does not exist for two of clause (1)'s states

response_events.note: The fallback no longer claims imas-efit records no edge constraint or points at a finished plan: the clause now takes the quantity from the output where the build records it and otherwise from the solver own behaviour under a changed setting.
The section now gives each clause its own starting field: the known states start as the known-answer study started them, and only the stored cases start from the stored imas-efit map.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `/nova/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/inverse-seam.svg` exists, `/nova/spine-efit-parity` and `equilibrium-fit-provenance` resolve (the latter at imas-efit `docs/plans/equilibrium-fit-provenance.html`), and §9's "Fit updates / forward calls" column is present in the §1 fragment.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s4 clause (2) carries a control (force ≥11 forward solves, which exceeds the 10× ceiling) that can fail, s8 clause (3) scaling rows, plasma current and conductor currents by 1.10 must leave the 1.5 % band, and s9 clause (3) scales the same inputs while clause (1) independently guarantees the §1 states converge, so the control is never vacuous.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the plan's record is the durable archive document `docs/evidence/archive/inverse-equilibrium-baseline-landed.html` (present), and §4's H200 job and §9's batch job are stated as receipts of that record with no node-local or scratch path named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the only labels are record vocabulary ("same magnetics, different constraints"), and no symbol, file or comment needs a tracker entry.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8 states imas-efit records the edge constraint "in neither place" and hands it to a plan that has already published it, and §9 starts "every case" from a stored imas-efit flux map that two of its clause (1) states do not have.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 delivers one cost receipt, §8 one imas-efit run on nova-written rows with its comparison against the generating state, §9 one in-iteration estimator with its case table.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` gives s4 `[s8]`, s3 `[s8]` and s9 `[]`, and each resolves: §4 times the §8 ITER case, §3 scores §8's rows, and §9's §2 stored cases are imas-efit's own committed equilibria rather than a landed §2 record, so "it waits on neither" holds.
